results.title: Swanand Kirkire reveals Sooraj Barjatya was impressed with his performance in Panchayat
results.description: Mumbai Nov 26 Actorsinger Swanand Kirkire shared that it was his performance in the series Panchayat that helped him came on board for Sooraj Barjatyaâs upcoming film Yeh Prem Mol Liya Kirkireâs performance as Sansaad Ji in the series Panchayat convinced the filmmaker of his acting abilities and helped him secure a pivotal role in the filmRecalling how the casting came about Kirkire shared that when Mukesh Chhabra suggested his name to Sooraj Barjatya for an important role in Yeh Prem Mol Liya the filmmaker was initially a little unsure about casting him as an actorTalking about the experience Kirkire said âSooraj ji has always been very fond of my songs and my work as a lyricist but when Mukesh Chhabra suggested my name for Yeh Prem Mol Liya I think he was initially a little unsure about me as an actor He had not really seen much of my acting work However when he watched me as Sansaad Ji in Panchayat he was quite impressed with my performanceâHe added âThat is when he immediately gave his nod and confirmed my casting in the film It was a lovely feeling because someone like Sooraj ji who has such a distinct understanding of cinema and performances trusted me with a pivotal role after watching my work It made the opportunity even more special for meâYeh Prem Mol Liya stars Ayushmann Khurrana and Sharvari in the lead roles with Anupam Kher Supriya Pathak Seema Pahwa Saumya Tandon Shaad Randhawa and Swanand Kirkire in supporting rolesThe film follows two people who fall in love and face family expectations misunderstandings and a twist on traditional marriage roles as they figure out what love and respect really mean Swanand won the National Film Award for Best Lyrics twice first in 2006 for the song Bande Me Tha DumVande Mataram from the film Lage Raho Munna Bhai and then in 2009for the song Behti Hawa Sa Tha Woh from the film 3 Idiots In 2018 at the 66th National Film Awards he won the National Film Award for Best Supporting Actor for the Marathi film Chumbak He made a cameo appearance as Sansad ji in Panchayat 3 and as Mansoor Khan Sahab in Qala to whose soundtrack he also contributed as a lyricist and singer IANS

results.title: Abhishek Kumar, Ankit Gupta complete 9th and 10th Jyotirlinga darshan, say ‘2 more to go’
results.description: Mumbai, Nov 26 (IANS) Television actors Abhishek Kumar and Ankit Gupta are soaking in spiritual bliss as they complete the darshan of the 9th and 10th Jyotirlingas, Mallikarjuna and Rameshwaram. Sharing glimpses from their spiritual journey, the actors expressed gratitude and said that the peace and contentment they experience at these sacred shrines are unmatched. Abhishek and Ankit shared in a collaborative post wrote: “Completed 9th and 10th Jyotirlingas, Mallikarjuna and Rameshwaram. Two more to go. Jitna sukoon aur shanti inse milke milti hai woh kahin nahi milti. Thank you God for everything. Har Har Mahadev. Feeling blessed.” Mallikarjuna Swamy Temple is dedicated to the deities Shiva and Parvati. It is significant to the Hindu sects of both Shaivism and Shaktism as this temple is referred to as one of the twelve Jyotirlingas of Shiva. Custom Ad: Multiplex Shiva is worshiped as Mallikarjuna and is represented by the lingam. His consort Parvati is depicted as Bhramaramba. The Rameswaram Jyotinga is enshrined at the Arulmigu Ramanathaswamy Temple on Rameswaram Island in Tamil Nadu, India, serving as one of the twelve Jyotirlingas. As per legends, Lord Rama worshipped Shiva here to atone for killing Ravana. Abhishek is best known for Udaariyaan, Bekaboo, and finishing as the first runner-up on Bigg Boss 17. He was also seen in , Khatron Ke Khiladi 14, Laughter Chefs, and Tere Mere Beech Mein. Meanwhile, Ankit is best known for his roles in Sadda Haq, Begusarai, Udaariyaan, Junooniyatt and Maati Se Bandhi Dor. In 2022, he participated in Bigg Boss 16. He made his acting debut in 2012 as Dr. Abhishek Kumar in Balika Vadhu. He was then seen portraying the character of Nalender Yadav in the Hindi film Tutiya Dil. He is currently seen in the television show Maati Se Bandhi Dor, which also stars actress Rutuja Bagwe. --IANS dc/

results.title: ‘Never tried to run that fast’: Harbhajan relives India’s historic 2001 BGT win
results.description: New Delhi, Nov 26 (IANS) Former India off-spinner Harbhajan Singh has revisited one of the most memorable moments of his international career, recalling how he scored the winning runs against Australia in the historic third Test of the 2001 Border-Gavaskar Trophy series in Kolkata. With India needing just two runs to seal a remarkable victory at Eden Gardens, Harbhajan faced Australian pacer Glenn McGrath and found an unguarded area at point, completing a memorable chase that helped India take a 2-1 lead in the three-match series. The former spinner recalled how McGrath’s field placement influenced his expectations before the delivery, with the Australian quick attempting to create uncertainty by altering his field. Expecting a short-pitched delivery, Harbhajan was instead confronted with a yorker but managed to bring his bat down in time to guide the ball through the vacant region. “In the end, when my turn came, two runs were needed to win and Glenn McGrath was bowling. I remember that he had changed the field, he removed the fielder from point and brought in an extra gully, just to make me think that he might bowl a short ball. So I was prepared for a bouncer because of the way the field was set,” Harbhajan told JioStar. Custom Ad: Multiplex After being forced to follow on in the Kolkata Test, Sourav Ganguly’s side produced one of the greatest comebacks in Test cricket history, overturning a substantial first-innings deficit to defeat Australia by 171 runs. VVS Laxman and Rahul Dravid were at the heart of the turnaround, scoring 281 and 180, respectively, in a monumental fifth-wicket partnership that transformed the course of the match. Harbhajan, who had already played a decisive role with the ball by claiming 13 wickets across Australia’s two innings, was ultimately entrusted with the task of getting India across the finishing line alongside Zaheer Khan. His contribution to the series had been equally extraordinary, with 32 wickets in three Tests, making him one of India’s biggest match-winners. “But he bluffed me, he bowled a yorker and my bat came down just in time, sending the ball in the exact direction from where he had removed the fielder at point. There was no fielder there, and once the ball went through, I don’t think I have ever tried to run that fast in my life. That moment of hitting the winning runs will always stay with me, because it was not just about those two runs, it was about beating Australia in that series after everything we had been through,” Harbhajan added. The Kolkata triumph also ended Australia’s remarkable run of 16 consecutive Test victories and became a defining moment in India’s cricketing history. The visitors had arrived in India as one of the most dominant teams in world cricket, but Ganguly’s side responded with a performance that changed the complexion of the series. India and Australia are set to renew their rivalry, with the five-Test Border-Gavaskar Trophy 2027 scheduled to begin on January 21. --IANS vi/bc

results.title: 'That wasn't very Pat Cummins-like...': Khawaja says 'personal attacks' from a friend were 'sad'
results.description: New Delhi, Nov 26 (IANS) Usman Khawaja has responded to Pat Cummins' hour-long presser, in which the skipper hit back at Khawaja’s explosive tampering claims and labelled them as ‘complete and utter nonsense’, admitting he was 'really hurt' by what Cummins said. Eight years after one of Australian cricket's most infamous incidents, Usman Khawaja claimed in his memoir "Sabr" that the entire Australian team knew about the ball-tampering attempts and argued that Bancroft, Smith, and David Warner should not have been punished alone. Cummins, who had been criticised for remaining silent since Khawaja dropped a bombshell in his memoir Sabr, finally broke his silence on the ball-tampering claims, holding a 70-minute press conference at Cricket NSW’s Silverwater headquarters earlier this month. Now responding to what Cummins said in his 70-minute presser, Khawaja told the Sky Sports Cricket Podcast, as quoted by Nine News. "It was the most surprised I’ve been for a long time. I wasn’t expecting that whatsoever. I thought Pat had this really great opportunity to come out and bring everyone together. He's such a great leader. I've said in the book that I love the person he is, love the leader he is, so I thought if anyone can bring us together, it's Pat." Custom Ad: Multiplex He added, "I had hoped that he would – I text him before, trying to do anything I could to make it easier, to do something to bring everyone in – but I realised that wasn’t going to happen when he first started talking, so that was really sad. "Then obviously the personal attacks were sad. I’m not going to lie about that, they hurt from a friend, someone you really respect. That wasn’t very Pat Cummins-like, very different to the Pat Cummins I know. "I know Pat, I know his family. They’re beautiful, so it was really hard to reconcile the Pat I knew and the Pat that was attacking me personally rather than attacking what I’m saying. That was by far one of the toughest days I’ve ever experienced." Khawaja said that while his relationship with Cummins took a hit amid the reignited controversy, he feels that there is hope of patching things up with Cummins. “I have nothing but love for Pat. I don’t judge people on certain instances or whatnot. That’s not how I live my life. That’s not how I function. Right now, are we talking? No, not really, but I've still got a lot of hope in my heart that at some stage if there's anyone that can bring everyone together, it's Pat. “He’s got the opportunity of power, whether it’s now or later. He took a real harsh route and I think because of that everything just blew up after that like even more. It doesn’t feel there is an ending right now, and that sucks for everyone,” Khawaja said. --IANS bc/vi
